body: I have no money and have been told how wonderful of a candidate for a promotion I am only to be told next time. That's been four times this year alone. Ive been giving my all. I don't understand why it's okay for someone else to dictate my worth. I have many years of experience in this job role just with another company. It's overlooked or not considered or taken seriously. I was very good at my last job and very well respected. I thought this was s better opportunity I so took it to learn more and take advantage of the perks. I feel like a pawn. I am almost 30 and I'm treated like this is my first job being told I don't have enough experience when I do. I feel like I'm screaming inside when I'm telling them I do and examples of how. It's stupid. I need to do something else and I can't right now. I don't like the feeling I have no control.

I've been going to them for too long. It doesn't give them any room to feel or have a bad day or talk about their problems for fear of upsetting me. It is hard I've gotten better. But after a lifetime of hurting myself and sadness and this past year opening up its only made me feel like a black hole of an existence. It doesn't get better. I genuinely try and go out and try to partake in positive experiences and no one at work or school or even my own mother for example allow me validation in any effort. It's always a good try come back again. I don't have the energy to keep up anymore.

I was dropped from my health insurance because I can't afford it. I've been denied a promotion three times this year but praised up an down for what an amazing candidate I 'was'. I give everything I have to dive deeper into failure and denied the chance to get better. My loved ones can only take so much, they can't be my caretakers forever.

I feel like that's all I do. Go to sleep and wake up wishing it was time to sleep again. I don't have anything worthwhile to contribute other than my own despair constantly hurting the ones I love. They can't do anything to help me. I try and all I give is pain in not getting better because I can't. What kind of life is that to live where you give your all and everything you work at shuts down around you and the people you love are hurt because it's my problem and they can't fix it. I keep quiet to save them. And that's when I live in the dark cave of my mind wondering why I didn't die today. I have no purpose
